name: School Navigation!
original_name: スクールなびげーしょん!
source:
An anthology consisting of multiple parts:

- [b]Youkoso, Shiritsu Seijuujika Gakuen e![/b] An illustrated audio drama about a transfer student being introduced to a wide variety of school clubs.
- [b]Happy Day[/b]. A bonus episode for the previous audio drama. Contains a voice actor Q&A at the end.
- [b]mislead ~Michibikareshi Hikari~[/b]. A visual novel about two orphan siblings fighting demons.
- A preview for an unreleased game titled [b]Kaze ga Fuku Machi[/b].
- A collection of illustrations titled [b]Kaze no Tayori[/b], accompanied by narration.
translation:
由多个部分组成的合集：

- [b]欢迎来到私立圣十字学院！[/b]一部插画广播剧，讲述转学生认识各种学校社团的故事。
- [b]Happy Day[/b]。上一部广播剧的特别篇，结尾包含声优问答。
- [b]mislead～被引导的光～[/b]。一部讲述孤儿兄妹对抗恶魔的视觉小说。
- 未发行游戏[b]风吹过的城镇[/b]的预告。
- 插画合集[b]风的消息[/b]，附带旁白。
